title: ‘Made in India: A Titan Story’ Wins Best Web Series (OTT) Award 2026 at 57th IFFI
subtitle: Jury recognises the series for celebrating Indian enterprise, perseverance and vision
body_text:
Posted On: 28 NOV 2026 7:33PM by PIB Mumbai Release ID: 2343187 Views: 207 A A Print Share X Facebook Instagram WhatsApp Copy Article Link
Read in: English Marathi Urdu हिन्दी Gujarati Malayalam Khasi Kannada
Goa, 28 November 2026 The Hindi docudrama series Made in India: A Titan Story , directed by Robbie Grewal, created by Prabhleen Sandhu and produced by Almighty Motion Picture, has won the Best Web Series (OTT) Award 2026 at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa. The award was presented at the festival’s closing ceremony tonight. The series was selected from five shortlisted titles across Indian languages, from a total of 46 entries received this year. The other shortlisted series were Devkhel (Marathi), directed by Chandrakant Lata Gaikwad; Musafir Cafe (Hindi), directed by Ruchir Arun; Maya Sabha (Telugu), directed by Deva Katta; and Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya (Hindi), directed by Himank Gaur. Speaking on behalf of the jury, Chairperson Shri Jamnandas Majethia outlined the selection process, noting that 12 entries were initially shortlisted before the final five nominees were identified. He said the jury looked for stories that touch the hearts of Indians, reflect the spirit of the nation and inspire audiences. He also highlighted the growing popularity of web series as content that families can enjoy together, appreciating the diversity of stories represented among the nominees. The jury recognised the winning series for celebrating homegrown enterprise and India’s industrial achievements, observing:“Stories of success deserve to be told and celebrated. Industrial achievements, in particular, offer powerful lessons in enterprise, perseverance and vision. This series captures that spirit beautifully and paves the way for more such narratives of dreams realised and aspirations fulfilled across Bharat. These are stories that deserve to be seen, shared and celebrated for the inspiration they offer to generations.” Instituted at the 54th IFFI in 2023 to recognise the expanding landscape of digital storytelling, the Best Web Series (OTT) Award carries a certificate and a cash prize of ₹10 lakh, shared equally among the director, creator and producer. Released in June 2026 on Amazon MX Player, Made in India: A Titan Story is a six-episode Hindi docudrama chronicling the rise of one of India's prominent consumer brands. Adapted from Vinay Kamath's book TITAN: Inside India's Most Successful Consumer Brand , the series features Jim Sarbh as Xerxes Desai and Naseeruddin Shah as JRD Tata. The award was among the highlights of the closing ceremony of the 57th IFFI, which brought nine days of international cinema and cultural exchange to a close.
